meaning:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.40
§ Jetheth = "a nail"
one of the dukes of Edom who came of Esau

elsewhere.note: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief…
Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
